svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="_nltJg_5iDoUDRhZjB9r" name="Page-1"> <mxGraphModel dx="3996" dy="2132" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': {'fontSize': '20px'}}}%%
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor C as Client
 participant RL as rateLimiter<br/>(middleware)
 participant Redis as Redis
 participant Ctrl as Auth Controller
 participant Svc as Auth Service
 participant Prisma as Prisma
 participant DB as PostgreSQL

 C->>+RL: POST /v1/auth/forgot-password<br/>{ email }

 RL->>+Redis: INCR rl:forgot-password:per-hour:ip:<ip>
 Note over RL,Redis: Lua script — atomic<br/>INCR + EXPIRE
 Redis-->>-RL: count

 alt over 5/hour
 RL-->>C: 429 Too Many Requests<br/>Retry-After: <ttl>
 else within limits
 RL->>+Ctrl: forward request
 Ctrl->>Ctrl: validate(ForgotPasswordDto)

 Ctrl->>+Svc: requestPasswordReset(email)

 Svc->>+Prisma: user.findUnique({ email })
 Prisma->>+DB: SELECT user_id FROM auth.users WHERE email = $1
 DB-->>-Prisma: rows / rows: []
 Prisma-->>-Svc: user or null

 alt email not found
 Note over Svc: return immediately —<br/>same response either way,<br/>prevents email enumeration
 Svc-->>-Ctrl: void
 else email found
 Note over Svc: crypto.randomBytes(32)<br/>.toString('hex')
 Svc->>Svc: generate reset token

 Svc->>+Redis: SET password_reset:<token><br/>value = userId, EX = 900 (15 min)
 Redis-->>-Svc: OK

 Note over Svc: logger.info()<br/>TODO — email delivery via<br/>Notification Service
 Svc->>Svc: log token generated

 Svc->>+Prisma: auditLog.create({ userId, event: 'user.password_reset_requested' })
 Prisma->>+DB: INSERT INTO auth.audit_logs (...)
 DB-->>-Prisma: ack
 Prisma-->>-Svc: ack

 Svc-->>-Ctrl: void
 end

 Ctrl-->>-C: 200 OK<br/>\"If an account exists,<br/>a reset link has been sent\"
 end
",
 "config": null
